2.4.4 Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) and Digital 
Platforms 
MOOCs are incredibly popular with an estimated 220 million enrolments in 2021 
(Shah, 2021). A meta-analysis by (Doo, et al., 2023) investigates the 
significance and effects of MOOCs. They expressed the advantages and 
disadvantages of the medium; some of the benefits include (1) high availability, 
(2) high flexibility for self-directed learning, (3) diverse range of learning 
processes. Self-directed learning has been shown to improve learner 
performance as described in 2.3.1. Despite these benefits, the platform has low 
retention rates (Padilla, et al., 2019), as well as that (Doo, et al., 2023) 
expresses concern with self-directed learning as again shown in 2.3.1.
